name: nib
purpose: Micro-states: hover, focus, chip and row highlights. Nothing travels more than 3px; the pen touches down and lifts.

name: leaf
purpose: House default. Toggles, chips, small entrances, anything that changes state under the finger. Critically damped — settles, never oscillates.

name: turn
purpose: A page turning: row expands onto its history, drawers, sheet detail, route changes. Fast out, long settle, no overshoot.

name: ruleDraw
purpose: The ruled line drawing itself left-to-right under a recognised name. First beat of the Recall.

name: markSet
purpose: Each return-mark landing, one per previous visit, 60ms apart. The only motion in the system allowed a touch of overshoot — being counted again should feel like something.

name: noteSurface
purpose: The marginal note the house kept about you, surfacing after the marks have finished landing. Last beat of the Recall.

name: recall

params.fires: once per familiar name per session; never on a first-time entry

purpose: This direction's signature moment. A name is set, the house draws its line under it, the returns stamp in one at a time, and the note it kept surfaces last — 'the house remembers you', performed in under a second.

name: reckon
purpose: Number tickers and KPI counts. The column never shivers because every figure is monospaced; the remembered comparison fades in only once the count has settled.

name: signStroke
purpose: The signature drawing itself when an order is approved. Fires once per approval, on one element, and is the only place in the product where a hand-drawn stroke animates.

name: arrive
purpose: First paint of a list, a tile row or a page of entries. First paint only — a working list never animates again while the user is reading it.
